senses.zh_definition: 马德琳：主要用于英语的女性名字，规范拼写为 Madeline。
senses.en_definition: A feminine given name used in English, related to Madeleine.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas perempuan dalam penggunaan bahasa Inggeris, berkaitan dengan nama Madeleine.
senses.nuances: 这是专有名词释义，并非已核实的 DBP 普通词条，因此不标为 official。常见英语读音包括 /ˈmæd.ə.lɪn/、/ˈmæd.lɪn/ 和 /ˈmæd.ə.laɪn/，应以本人读法为准。以下搭配为人名使用框架，不代表固定高频词汇搭配。[Behind the Name：Madeline](https://www.behindthename.com/name/madeline)

etymology.historical_story: Madeline is an English form of French Madeleine, itself a form of Magdalene. Its name history ultimately connects with the place name Magdala. Another cultural association comes from Ludwig Bemelmans's children's books: their heroine is Madeline, and the series began in 1939. These are naming and literary connections rather than Malay word formation. [Madeline](https://www.behindthename.com/name/madeline), [Madeleine](https://www.behindthename.com/name/madeleine)
